verdict.rationale: Inviting an external accountant with role-scoped access is a fair question for accounting software, but the evidence pack never documents user invitations, accountant access, or permission roles. The OAuth docs cover authorising third-party apps to access data, which is an adjacent API mechanism, not inviting a person with a scoped role, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can invite my external accountant or bookkeeper with role-scoped access to review and adjust the books
